snippet.title: Crossings - Meta Quest 3 Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
The afterlife awaits in CROSSINGS, a Norse-inspired VR roguelike where physical combat, co-op chaos, and haunted worlds collide.

🚨 Releasing December 18 on Meta Quest 🚨
Pre-order now on Meta Quest with 10% off — $8.99 (launch price $9.99).

Step into the Nordic afterlife and fight your way through shifting realms of fate.
Block, dodge, swing, and cast with fully physical combat while facing trolls, draugr, spectral assassins, and myth-touched bosses — either solo or alongside a friend in seamless VR co-op.

Discover lost spirits, unlock outfits and weapons with Fate Strings, uncover hidden paths, and piece together a world suspended between death and memory.

🔥 CROSSINGS launches December 18
🥽 Meta Quest & SteamVR
💰 Pre-order on Meta Quest: 10% off — $8.99

Meta Quest: https://www.meta.com/experiences/crossings/7631852763493874/

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2782960/Crossings/

Presskit: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qbApvF-iGQZ04GVbrPNZ_BzqrFIN8K-q?usp=sharing

Developed by Neat Corp (Budget Cuts, Garden of the Sea)
Published by Creature (Maestro, Prison Boss Prohibition, THRASHER)
